konu: Wild Animals: Describing the frequency of actions, Making simple inquiries, Making simple suggestions, Talking about past events (Giving explanations/reasons) and Wildlife Protection
ciktilar: Describes the frequency of actions and natural habits of wild animals using adverbs of frequency (E7.4.S1).
Makes simple inquiries and answers questions about wild animals' habitats, diet, size, weight and lifespan (E7.4.L1 / E7.4.R1).
Makes simple suggestions using 'should / shouldn't' and talks about past events giving explanations and reasons about extinct and endangered species (E7.4.S2 / E7.4.W1).
hatirla: Sıklık zarfları (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) ve 'How often?' alışkanlıkları anlatır.
Hayvan sorgularında Where (habitat), What (diet), How much (weight) ve How long (lifespan) kullanılır.
Doğayı koruma önerilerinde 'should / shouldn't + V1', geçmişte soyu tükenenlerde Past Tense kullanılır.

sorular.soru: Görseldeki öneri kartlarından yararlanarak yaban hayatını korumak için 'should' ve 'shouldn't' ile iki cümle yazınız.
sorular.cevap: We should protect natural habitats and plant trees. We shouldn't hunt wild animals for their fur or tusk.
sorular.gorsel: <svg viewBox="0 0 360 115" style="width:100%;max-height:24mm;display:block;margin:1mm auto;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="7-ingilizce-14 yazma rehberi"><rect x="4" y="4" width="352" height="107" rx="6" fill="#eef1f6" stroke="#2451d6" stroke-width="0.75"/><text x="180.0" y="19.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.6" font-family="Noto Sans, sans-serif" font-weight="700" fill="#2451d6">WRITING GUIDE: WILDLIFE PROTECTION CAMPAIGN</text><rect x="12" y="27" width="162" height="77" rx="6" fill="#e8eefe" stroke="#2451d6" stroke-width="0.75"/><text x="93.0" y="45.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8.8" font-family="Noto Sans, sans-serif" font-weight="700" fill="#2451d6">Positive Suggestions (Should)</text><text x="93.0" y="66.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="7.8" font-family="Noto Sans, sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#0b2257">We should protect national parks.</text><text x="93.0" y="86.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="7.4" font-family="Noto Sans, sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#5b6479">We should charities like WWF.</text><rect x="186" y="27" width="162" height="77" rx="6" fill="#fff1df" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="0.75"/><text x="267.0" y="45.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8.8" font-family="Noto Sans, sans-serif" font-weight="700" fill="#d97706">Negative Warnings (Shouldn’t)</text><text x="267.0" y="66.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="7.8" font-family="Noto Sans, sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#0b2257">We shouldn’t destroy bamboo forests.</text><text x="267.0" y="86.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="7.4" font-family="Noto Sans, sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#5b6479">We shouldn’t buy fur coats or ivory.</text></svg>
